description: Source code for MS5837 pressure sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including measurement functions, compensation algorithms, and device initialization.

methods.name: ms5837_get_measurement
methods.description: Reads measurement data from the sensor via I2C, converts from big-endian to CPU byte order.

methods.name: ms5837_compensate_30
methods.description: Performs first and second order compensation for MS5837-30 sensor type.

methods.name: ms5837_compensate_02
methods.description: Performs first and second order compensation for MS5837-02B sensor type.

methods.name: ms5837_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches pressure and temperature measurements and applies compensation.

methods.name: ms5837_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves temperature or pressure data as sensor_value.

methods.name: ms5837_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes, such as oversampling rate.

methods.name: ms5837_read_prom
methods.description: Reads calibration data from sensor's PROM.

methods.name: ms5837_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, reads calibration data, and sets compensation function based on device type.
